description: Your entire Zotero research library, searchable offline — version-based incremental sync into SQLite with full-text search no other Zotero tool has.

tools.name: collections_get
tools.description: One collection by key. Required: collection_key. Returns the Collection.

tools.name: collections_items
tools.description: Items in a collection (including children). Required: collection_key. Optional: q, limit (default: 25). Returns array of Item.

tools.name: collections_list
tools.description: All collections. Optional: since, limit (default: 25). Returns array of Collection.

params.name: since
params.description: Only collections modified after this library version

tools.name: collections_subcollections
tools.description: Subcollections of a collection. Required: collection_key. Returns array of Collection.

tools.name: collections_top
tools.description: Top-level collections. Returns array of Collection.

tools.name: deleted_list
tools.description: Keys of items/collections/searches/tags deleted since a library version. Required: since. Returns the Deleted.

tools.name: fulltext_changed
tools.description: Attachment keys whose full-text content changed since a version. Required: since. Returns the FulltextVersions.

tools.name: items_children
tools.description: Child notes and attachments of an item. Required: item_key. Returns array of Item.

tools.name: items_fulltext
tools.description: Full-text content of an attachment item. Required: item_key. Returns the Fulltext.

tools.name: items_get
tools.description: Get one item by key. Required: item_key. Optional: include, style. Returns the Item.

params.name: style
params.description: CSL citation style for bib/citation includes

tools.name: items_list
tools.description: List items. Supports q (phrase search), qmode=everything (includes fulltext), tag filters with || OR and - negation, itemType, and since=<version>. Optional: q, qmode, item-type (plus 7 more). Returns array of Item.

params.name: q
params.description: Quick search phrase (titles and creators by default)

params.name: item-type
params.description: Filter by item type (supports || OR and - negation)

params.name: tag
params.description: Filter by tag (supports || OR and - negation)

params.name: since
params.description: Only objects modified after this library version

params.name: format
params.description: Response format: json (default), keys, versions, bibtex, ris, csljson...

tools.name: items_top
tools.description: Top-level items only (no child notes/attachments). Optional: q, qmode, tag (plus 2 more). Returns array of Item.

tools.name: items_trash
tools.description: Items in the trash. Optional: limit (default: 25). Returns array of Item.

tools.name: keys_current
tools.description: Resolve the current API key to userID, username, and access scopes (doctor probe + userID discovery). Returns the KeyInfo.

tools.name: searches_get
tools.description: One saved search. Required: search_key. Returns the SavedSearch.

tools.name: searches_list
tools.description: All saved searches. Returns array of SavedSearch.

tools.name: tags_list
tools.description: All tags in the library. Optional: q, limit (default: 25). Returns array of Tag.
